name: Ore Quota
description: A dig crew worker needs emergency ore intake.|Production is behind and the refinery will shut down if quota fails. Bring ore fast and secure supply lines.

text: The pit's unstable and I can't hit quota alone.
If command sees this output, I'm done.
I need 15 Nisoc ores before shift ends.
Bring them and I'll open trade access for you.

hasItemText: You saved my shift. Refinery can run tonight.
Come back anytime—I'll cut you better rates than other vendors.

popup.title: Quest completed!
popup.text: @green@You have just finished @crimson@Ore Quota@green@. You've been awarded @crimson@2000@green@ Mining experience!
